seo.title: Art, Live Music & Events | The Talisman, Karen, Nairobi
seo.description: Local artists on our walls, live music and DJ nights at The Talisman in Karen, Nairobi. A hub for art and culture on Ngong Road.

hero_image.alt: The lounge hung with bold paintings by local artists

top.intro: Local artists on the walls, live music and DJs. Always more than a dining room.

art.heading:
Local artists,
*on our walls.*
art.intro: We support local artists and feature their work regularly. Almost all of it is for sale.

image.alt: A large oil painting of dhows and a Kenyan flag, hung above a carved chest
Bird and elephant canvases hung along the red dining room wall
Paintings shown on easels beside a table in the Talisman garden
An elephant portrait on an easel beside the garden fountain
A local artist painting zebras on the terrace
Carved pillars, stained glass and collected pieces in the dining room

music.heading:
The band starts
*when the plates clear.*
music.intro: Jazz and soul by the fireplace. No stage, no tickets. Once the tables clear, the DJs take over.

image_1.alt: A guitarist singing under the warm lamps at Talisman
The guitarist playing beneath the wall art at Talisman

image_2.alt: Singers and saxophone under the fairy lights in the garden

image_3.alt: The bar in full flow at Talisman

nights.text: Film nights and art openings run through the year alongside the music.
